claims.text: The NAKDIMON model's performance on the DICTA test set differs from the new test set due to its training on different portions of the corpus, specifically not being trained on the Dicta portion.

The character accuracy (CHA) and word accuracy (WOR) metrics reflect different aspects of performance, with CHA focusing on individual character decisions and WOR on overall word correctness, which may explain their differing scores.
